description: This file contains functions related to file system operations during a checkout process in a Git-like version control system, including directory creation, removal, file handling, and entry checkout procedures.

methods.name: void create_directories(const char * path,int path_len,const struct checkout * state)
methods.description: Creates missing directories along a given path, handling symlinks and existing directories.

methods.name: void remove_subtree(struct strbuf * path)
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory and all its contents.

methods.name: int create_file(const char * path,unsigned int mode)
methods.description: Creates a new file with specified permissions, ensuring it does not already exist.

methods.name: void * read_blob_entry(const struct cache_entry * ce,size_t * size)
methods.description: Reads a blob object (file contents) from the object database, returning its data and size.

methods.name: int open_output_fd(char * path,const struct cache_entry * ce,int to_tempfile)
methods.description: Opens a file descriptor for writing, either as a temporary file or directly for output.

methods.name: int fstat_checkout_output(int fd,const struct checkout * state,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Performs an fstat system call on a file descriptor to obtain file status info, using fallback logic.

methods.name: int streaming_write_entry(const struct cache_entry * ce,char * path,struct stream_filter * filter,const struct checkout * state,int to_tempfile,int * fstat_done,struct stat * statbuf)
methods.description: Streams blob data directly to a file descriptor, handling filtering and cleanup on errors.

methods.name: void enable_delayed_checkout(struct checkout * state)
methods.description: Initializes a delayed checkout structure within the checkout state to postpone file writing.

methods.name: int finish_delayed_checkout(struct checkout * state,int show_progress)
methods.description: Completes all delayed checkout operations, handling filtering, progress display, and error reporting.

methods.name: void update_ce_after_write(const struct checkout * state,struct cache_entry * ce,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Updates cache entry metadata after writing to disk, including stat info and cache flags.

methods.name: int write_entry(struct cache_entry * ce,char * path,struct conv_attrs * ca,const struct checkout * state,int to_tempfile,int * nr_checkouts)
methods.description: Writes a cache entry to disk, handling symlinks, submodules, file conversions, and permissions.

methods.name: int check_path(const char * path,int len,struct stat * st,int skiplen)
methods.description: Checks a path with lstat, with special handling for directory-only paths and skip length.

methods.name: void mark_colliding_entries(const struct checkout * state,struct cache_entry * ce,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Marks cache entries as collided if their paths or inodes match, used during checkout to handle conflicts.

methods.name: int checkout_entry_ca(struct cache_entry * ce,struct conv_attrs * ca,const struct checkout * state,char * topath,int * nr_checkouts)
methods.description: Checks out a given cache entry, creating or updating files or directories as needed, with conflict and submodule handling.

methods.name: void unlink_entry(const struct cache_entry * ce,const char * super_prefix)
methods.description: Removes a cache entry, including submodules and directory trees.

methods.name: int remove_or_warn(unsigned int mode,const char * file)
methods.description: Removes a file or directory, emitting warnings/errors according to its mode.

methods.name: int string_is_not_null(struct string_list_item * item,void * data UNUSED)

ctags.pattern: /^static int check_path(const char *path, int len, struct stat *st, int skiplen)$/
ctags.signature: (const char * path,int len,struct stat * st,int skiplen)

ctags.name: checkout_entry_ca
ctags.signature: (struct cache_entry * ce,struct conv_attrs * ca,const struct checkout * state,char * topath,int * nr_checkouts)

ctags.name: create_directories
ctags.signature: (const char * path,int path_len,const struct checkout * state)

ctags.name: create_file
ctags.pattern: /^static int create_file(const char *path, unsigned int mode)$/

ctags.name: fstat_checkout_output
ctags.pattern: /^int fstat_checkout_output(int fd, const struct checkout *state, struct stat *st)$/
ctags.signature: (int fd,const struct checkout * state,struct stat * st)

ctags.name: mark_colliding_entries
ctags.signature: (const struct checkout * state,struct cache_entry * ce,struct stat * st)

ctags.signature: (const struct checkout * state,struct cache_entry * ce,struct stat * st)
